title: 🐛 fix(python): read a UTF-8 BOM in pyproject.toml and base_python_file

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+A leading UTF-8 byte order mark in ``pyproject.toml`` no longer breaks ``dependency_groups`` or reading the package's
+static dependencies from ``[project]``, and one in a ``base_python_file`` such as ``.python-version`` is no longer read
+as part of the Python version.

@@ -24,8 +24,7 @@ def resolve(root: Path, groups: set[str]) -> set[Requirement]:
     if not pyproject_file.exists():
         msg = f"no pyproject.toml found at {pyproject_file} to read dependency groups from"
         raise Fail(msg)
-    with pyproject_file.open("rb") as file_handler:
-        pyproject = tomllib.load(file_handler)
+    pyproject = tomllib.loads(pyproject_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
     if "dependency-groups" not in pyproject:
         msg = f"no dependency groups defined in {pyproject_file}"
         raise Fail(msg)

@@ -16,8 +16,7 @@ def resolve_extras_static(root: Path, extras: set[str]) -> list[Requirement] | N
     pyproject_file = root / "pyproject.toml"
     if not pyproject_file.exists():
         return None
-    with pyproject_file.open("rb") as file_handler:
-        pyproject = tomllib.load(file_handler)
+    pyproject = tomllib.loads(pyproject_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
     if "project" not in pyproject:
         return None
     project = pyproject["project"]

@@ -765,6 +765,14 @@ def test_base_python_file_global_testenv(tox_project: ToxProjectCreator) -> None
     assert f"py{_PY_VER_NODOT}" in result.out
 
 
+def test_base_python_file_with_utf8_bom(tox_project: ToxProjectCreator) -> None:
+    project = tox_project({"tox.ini": "[testenv:mypy]\npackage=skip\nbase_python_file=.python-version\n"})
+    (project.path / ".python-version").write_bytes(f"\ufeff{_PY_VER}\n".encode())
+    result = project.run("c", "-e", "mypy", "-k", "base_python")
+    result.assert_success()
+    assert f"base_python = {_PY_VER}\n" in result.out
+
+
 def test_base_python_file_not_used_when_not_set(tox_project: ToxProjectCreator) -> None:
     toml = 'env_list = ["lint"]\n\n[env_run_base]\npackage = "skip"\ncommands = [["python", "-c", "print(1)"]]\n'
     result = tox_project({"tox.toml": toml}).run("c", "-e", "lint", "-k", "base_python")

@@ -491,6 +491,13 @@ def test_dependency_groups_nested_extra_names(tox_project: ToxProjectCreator) ->
     assert resolve(project.path, {"test"}) == {Requirement("first>=1"), Requirement("second>=2")}
 
 
+def test_dependency_groups_pyproject_with_utf8_bom(tox_project: ToxProjectCreator) -> None:
+    project: Final = tox_project({"pyproject.toml": '[dependency-groups]\ntest = ["first>=1"]\n'})
+    pyproject = project.path / "pyproject.toml"
+    pyproject.write_bytes(b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + pyproject.read_bytes())
+    assert resolve(project.path, {"test"}) == {Requirement("first>=1")}
+
+

@@ -741,6 +748,12 @@ def test_resolve_extras_static_no_pyproject(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
     assert resolve_extras_static(tmp_path, set()) is None
 
 
+def test_resolve_extras_static_pyproject_with_utf8_bom(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    content = b'\xef\xbb\xbf[project]\nname = "demo"\nversion = "1.0"\ndependencies = ["first>=1"]\n'
+    (tmp_path / "pyproject.toml").write_bytes(content)
+    assert resolve_extras_static(tmp_path, set()) == [Requirement("first>=1")]
+
